(Optional) Knowledge of programming languages (Python, Solidity, Java) and SQL

What we offer
Attractive compensation
Work in an experienced team of traders within an international financial institution
Opportunities to develop new skills
Exceptionally friendly working atmosphere
Flexible working hours (shift system)
Participation in ambitious and interesting projects
Modern office in a prime location (Skyliner tower, right next to the Rondo Daszyńskiego metro station)
